notes: Renders a native <button>, or an <a> when it navigates — never a div with a click handler.
The label is the accessible name; an icon-only button needs an aria-label.
Focus is visible on the control itself (2.4.7) and the target is at least 24x24 (2.5.8).
Disabled is conveyed to assistive tech, not by colour alone (1.4.1).

Focus state shows a visible focus ring (WCAG 2.2 AA · SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible). Contrast holds in both themes because content/default resolves to a contrasting value per mode (SC 1.4.3 Contrast Minimum).

decisions.question: Scaffolded as button (interactive: state axis has hover, focus, active; interactive, but nothing says which kind). Confirm, or re-run npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=link --archetype=<link-card|card|collection>.
decisions.chose: button — interactive: state axis has hover, focus, active; interactive, but nothing says which kind
alternatives: link-card: A card that is one link: illustration or icon, a headline, optional description, an arrow affordance. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name.
card: A non-interactive content card; actions live in a slot.
collection: A row, grid or scroller of one repeated unit.
checkbox / radio: A selection control with a checked state, usually paired with a label.
toggle / switch: A binary on/off control that applies immediately.
input / field: Accepts typed input. Label, value, placeholder, and an error state.
badge / tag / chip: A small label. Non-interactive unless it is dismissible.
pagination: Moves between pages of content.
accordion: A disclosure: a trigger that shows and hides a region of content. Open or closed is a prop a consumer sets, not an interaction state.
select / dropdown: A choice among options. The native <select> does the choosing; the design styles the trigger around it.
helper text: Guidance or a message under a field: hint, error, success. Associated with its field, never floating.
list: A sequence of like items — features, links, steps. The items are the content; the list is the rhythm.
decisions.evidence: decided by heuristic; token namespaces content×2, focus-ring×1; state axis default/hover/focus/active

decisions.question: label-wrap, call-to-action, underline, end-icon, frame, s2a-icon-chevron-right, icon-color have no class of their own in link.css. The design names these parts separately and the code does not. Split the class, or model them as one part.
decisions.chose: kept a derived selector that matches nothing
decisions.fix: Set anatomy.root.parts.<part>.selector to the real class, or add the class to link.css.

decisions.question: "href" navigates, but the archetype's element is <button>. Rendered as <button> it is not reachable as a link, cannot be middle-clicked or opened in a new tab, and is announced with the wrong role. Should this component navigate at all?
decisions.fix: If it should never navigate, remove the "href" prop. If it always navigates, set anatomy.root.element to "a" and drop elementByProp.

decisions.question: 16 values in the design are set with no variable behind them: root padding-top@kind=action = 6px; root padding-bottom@kind=action = 6px; root padding-top@kind=text = 2px; root padding-bottom@kind=text = 2px; root/label-wrap gap = 1px; root/label-wrap/underline height = 1px; …. A literal in a contract is a token gap: bind the property to an S2A variable in Figma and re-extract, or keep the raw: value and record why here.
decisions.chose: carried them through as raw: values so the render matches the file
decisions.fix: In Figma, bind the layer's property to an S2A variable, then re-extract; or replace the raw: with a {s2a.…} token that resolves to the same value.
